title: Reincarnated Escort Warrior
description: After living his entire life as a crippled porter unable to learn proper martial arts, a man dies during an escort mission after confronting mountain bandits. He awakens reincarnated as Lee Jungryong, the good-for-nothing fourth young master of the Heavenly Dragon Escort Agency. With a second chance at life, he sets out to become the greatest escort warrior in the martial world.
author: Park Shin
